companies.originalDescription: Teach robots new skills through natural language and run reliably in production in minutes. Mbodi combines generative AI and agent orchestration, turning everyday language and quick demos into precise, reliable robot actions for industrial automation.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是工业机器人的人工智能控制系统。想象你是一家工厂的自动化工程师，需要让机器人学会一个新任务，比如分拣不同形状的零件，但传统编程需要数周时间，而且难以应对变化。Mbodi AI 让你通过自然语言和快速演示来教机器人新技能，几分钟内就能在生产环境中可靠运行。它结合了生成式人工智能和智能体编排，把日常语言和演示转化为精确的机器人动作。这家公司来自 YC 春季批次，目前团队六人，正在招聘。

companies.name: Hemlock
companies.originalOneLiner: Force-sensing wristband for training robotic AI
companies.originalDescription: Every serious robotics lab is bottlenecked on the same thing: demonstration data. The field has converged on egocentric video and hand pose as the substrate, and both are now cheap to collect at scale. What neither of them contains is force. A video of someone picking up an egg and a video of someone picking up a rock are nearly identical in pixel space and nearly identical in joint angles. They differ almost entirely in a quantity nobody is recording. Policies trained without it learn geometry and inherit no sense of touch. Hemlock closes that gap at the source. Our device, the Bracelet, is a wrist-worn surface EMG band that reads the electrical activity of the forearm muscles that actually drive the hand, which means it recovers contraction force directly rather than inferring it from motion. This distinction is the whole thesis: force cannot be reconstructed downstream of kinematics, because a hand squeezing hard isometrically and a hand resting can occupy the identical pose. Muscle signal is the only non-invasive channel that separates them.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是用于训练机器人的力传感腕带。想象你是一个机器人实验室的研究员，正在收集人类操作物体的演示数据，但视频和手部姿态只能记录运动，无法记录力的大小。拿起鸡蛋和拿起石头，在视频上看起来几乎一样，但力完全不同。Hemlock 的腕带通过表面肌电信号读取前臂肌肉的电气活动，直接恢复收缩力，而不是从运动中推断。这解决了机器人学习触觉的关键问题。这家公司来自 YC 秋季批次，目前一人，正在招聘。

companies.name: Rasyn
companies.originalOneLiner: Making chemicals 100,000x faster
companies.originalDescription: We builds foundational AI models for chemistry. Almost nothing you buy is a single chemical. Products like datacenter coolant, GPU thermal paste, paint, and glue are formulations, which are mixtures of around ten ingredients each, and demand for them has grown quickly because of AI and EVs. Designing a new formulation is essentially a search problem, because there are more possible mixtures than anyone could ever test, and none of them can be predicted in advance. As a result, bringing a single formulation to market today takes three to five years of trial and error in a lab. Our models predict how a mixture will behave far faster than the standard methods used today, which lets us design new formulations in weeks rather than years, at a fraction of the cost. To prove this, we used them to invent three chemicals that never existed before, including a PFAS-free coolant for datacenters, and we have since synthesized and patented all three. We are already working with some of the largest manufacturers to design formulations for them, and we are building our own lab to generate the data that will train our next models.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是化学领域的基础人工智能模型。想象你是一名材料研发工程师，需要设计一种新的数据中心冷却液，但传统方法需要在实验室里反复试验，一个配方可能要花三到五年才能上市。Rasyn 的模型能比现有方法快得多地预测混合物行为，让你在几周内而不是几年内设计出新配方。他们已经用这个模型发明了三种前所未有的化学品，包括一种不含全氟和多氟烷基物质的冷却液。这家公司来自 YC 夏季批次，团队三人。

companies.name: RealPact

They find property records like deeds, tax records, permits, parcel data, and MLS information, then use that data to fill out contracts, organize documents, track deadlines, and help brokerages close deals faster. We are starting by automating transactions and will expand into other parts of brokerage operations. Much of the software used across the real estate industry is outdated. With today’s advances in AI, we can build agents that handle this operational work and create modern software around how brokerages actually work. We currently sell to brokerages in New Hampshire and are expanding quickly.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是房地产经纪公司的人工智能操作系统。想象你是一家房地产经纪公司的交易协调员，每天要处理大量文书工作，比如查找房产记录、填写合同、跟踪截止日期。RealPact 的人工智能智能体可以自动查找地契、税务记录、许可证和挂牌信息，然后用这些数据填写合同、整理文件、跟踪截止日期，帮助更快完成交易。它目前在新罕布什尔州销售，并正在扩展到经纪业务的其他运营环节。这家公司来自 YC 夏季批次，团队两人。

companies.originalOneLiner: AI Verification for Insurance

companies.story: 这家公司做的是保险理赔的人工智能核验。想象你是一家农业保险公司的理赔员，收到一份关于农作物损失的索赔，传统上需要派人现场查勘，过程缓慢且成本高。Verdex 使用卫星图像等数据流来核验索赔，让你能立即处理，节省大量资金。它目前已经为超过百分之十一的美国农田提供保险服务。这家公司来自 YC 冬季批次，团队两人。

readings.title: Nvidia’s AI advantage is moving beyond the GPU
readings.story: 很多人以为做人工智能的公司，只要把芯片堆得够多就赢了。可这几年你会发现，算力只是入场券，真正拉开差距的，是芯片之外那些看不见的东西。比如怎么把几千张卡调度得像一台机器，怎么让模型训练不中断，怎么让成本降下来。这篇 TechCrunch 的文章，讲的就是英伟达的优势正在从硬件本身，蔓延到这些软功夫上。它适合那些想理解 人工智能 行业竞争逻辑的人读。读的时候，你可以留意作者是怎么把“优势”这个词拆开的，是看它讲的是技术壁垒，还是生态锁定，又或者是客户离不开它的那些日常细节。

readings.title: Show HN: Player vs. Computer
readings.story: 你有没有想过，自己写一个小游戏，人和电脑对战，然后把它发到网上，会有人认真看吗？在 Hacker News 上，每天都有这样的“Show HN”帖子，作者把自己的作品摆出来，接受大家的挑刺和夸奖。这个叫“Player vs. Computer”的项目，看起来简单，却可能藏着作者对交互、对难度设计、对程序架构的不少心思。技术社区愿意讨论它，往往不是因为功能多炫，而是因为它触到了某个共同的痒处。读的时候，你可以先点开链接看看它的代码或演示，然后想想，如果是你，会怎么实现人机对战，又会卡在哪个环节。

readings.title: [AINews] OpenAI shuts off Cursor
readings.story: 在 人工智能 工具圈，新闻总是来得又快又猛，今天这家公司发布新模型，明天那家平台改了规则。可真正值得琢磨的，不是新闻本身，而是它为什么发生。这篇来自 Latent Space 的报道，标题里写着“OpenAI 关掉了 Cursor 的通道”，听起来像是一场突然的断供，但背后往往是商业策略、技术路线或者合作条款的博弈。如果你平时用这类编程助手，或者在做相关产品，你可能会好奇，一个工具突然不能用了，用户会怎么反应，市场又会怎么调整。读的时候，别只盯着谁对谁错，试着看作者如何把一件孤立的事件，放进更大的行业图景里。

companies.name: Corvera

companies.story: Corvera 是一家为人工智能原生的消费品品牌提供数据基础设施的公司。想象你是一家新兴零食品牌的运营负责人，品牌刚上线几款产品，各种销售、库存和营销数据散落在不同系统里，每次想用人工智能工具分析都因为数据格式混乱而失败。Corvera 能把所有数据统一成人工智能工具能读懂的格式，通过 MCP 协议直接接入 Claude 或 ChatGPT，让你不用数据工程师也能快速搭建看板、自动化供应链和品类管理流程。这家公司来自 YC 冬季批次，团队四人，上线四周就做到了月经常性收入三万多美元，服务十二个品牌，周增长百分之一百三十，这种速度在数据基础设施领域相当少见。

companies.name: Arlo Industries
companies.originalOneLiner: Track drones and missiles without radars - Accurate, Passive, Scalable
companies.originalDescription: Arlo Industries is building a network of sensors that precisely tracks stealthy drones and aerial threats better than radars. This capability does not exist yet because traditional radars are built on past war doctrines designed to protect single, centralised assets. Modern warfare, however, demands wide-area, persistent coverage that is both passive and economically scalable. By utilising a mesh architecture, Arlo Industries unlocks unprecedented asymmetric economics. The network is fundamentally built to scale: the cost of adding sensors grows linearly, but the tracking accuracy increases exponentially, delivering highly resilient, persistent coverage for a fraction of the cost of legacy systems. Deo founded Arlo Industries after spending over 6 years in the Israeli defence ecosystem, where he lived through multiple conflicts and experienced the Iron Dome and other systems in action against ICBMs and the infamous Shahed drones. Learning exactly how these defence systems could be improved after a Shahed exploded close to his apartment, he built Arlo Industries around the core philosophy that conflict should be concise & precise. The people behind Arlo1 includes a PhD in drones and autonomy and military experts. Arlo Industries has actively showcased this technology directly to Ukrainian militaries on the frontlines, as well as to operators across Europe and the USA.
companies.story: Arlo Industries 做的是国防科技里的无源传感器网络，用来追踪无人机和导弹。想象你是一个防空指挥中心的军官，雷达屏幕上有几个小点，但你知道那是诱饵，真正的威胁藏在低空慢速的无人机群后面，传统雷达要么漏掉，要么被干扰。Arlo 的传感器不发射信号，而是被动接收周围环境的电磁波，通过多个传感器组成网状结构，让追踪精度随着节点增加而指数级提升，成本却只是线性增长。创始人曾在以色列国防生态待了六年，亲历过铁穹系统，团队三人，正在招聘，来自 YC 春季批次，这种被动式广域覆盖的思路可能改变现代战争的防御逻辑。

companies.name: Antigen
companies.originalOneLiner: Continuous offensive security for the enterprise.

companies.name: Sourcebot
companies.originalOneLiner: Helping humans and AI agents understand massive codebases
companies.originalDescription: Sourcebot is an open source code understanding platform for massive codebases. We’re used by thousands of engineers in some of the largest companies in the world, including NVIDIA, Red Hat, Wikimedia, and Arista Networks. Understanding code, not writing it, is the primary bottleneck for large engineering teams. For developers, this means onboarding onto complex codebases faster. For AI agents, it means getting the necessary code context to minimize hallucinations and maximize cohesion within the wider codebase. Sourcebot solves this by giving developers and AI agents the ability to regex search across millions of lines of code instantly, as well as ask questions across thousands of repos using any flagship reasoning model. Being open source and on-prem, we can get deployed in enterprises within minutes before other tools even get approval. We met a decade ago at McGill University and have been building together full time for over 2 years. We’ve personally felt the pain of understanding large codebases while working at Microsoft, EA, Ubisoft, Google, and Meta.
companies.story: Sourcebot 做的是开源代码理解平台，专门解决大型代码库的阅读难题。想象你刚加入一家大公司，接手一个有几百万行代码的老项目，光是搞清楚某个模块怎么调用就要翻半天，更别提让智能体去改代码了。Sourcebot 让你能用正则表达式在几百万行代码里瞬间搜索，还能用各种主流推理模型对几千个仓库提问，帮你和人工智能代理快速找到需要的上下文，减少幻觉。这家公司来自 YC 秋季批次，团队三人，正在招聘，已经被英伟达、红帽、维基媒体和 Arista Networks 等公司使用，开源且支持本地部署，几分钟就能上线，比很多需要审批的工具快得多。

companies.name: Perseus Defense
companies.originalOneLiner: America's Golden Dome for Drones
companies.originalDescription: Perseus Defense is building a mass-manufactured Counter UAS solution for the Department of Defense and Department of Homeland Security. Current solutions are one-to-one, too dangerous for use on U.S. soil, and orders of magntiude more expensive than the threats they defeat. Our self-guided missile platform is man-portable and multi-domain capable. It senses, engages, and eliminates threats with drastically reduced cost per engagement over existing kinetic solutions. Solving this critical national security problem requires understanding complex DoD needs along with actual rocket science including aerodynamics, guidance, navigation, control, and much more. Jason and Steve met at Penn State while they pursued their PhD and MS in aerospace engineering, respectively. Their past experiences designing space helicopters for NASA, making Boeing airliners land autonomously, controlling swarms of unmanned autonomous systems, teaching aerospace engineering at Stanford, winning multiple ONR and DOE engineering competitions, and founding an international drone competition makes them the perfect team to create transformative solutions protecting our service members. "If you build this, it will be mandatory equipment for every truck, boat, and convoy in the U.S. Military. We're talking thousands of units." - Former DoD Procurement Officer The White House just released Executive Order, "Unleashing American Drone Dominance" which adds billions of dollars, government support, and streamlined regulations to enable the development of our product. Traction: Jason and Steve used more than 100 end-user interviews across the DoD and DHS to shape the product to something of critical need to both boots on the ground and DoD purchasers. In 8 short weeks following a strict 2-week design-build-test cycle, the team has gone through 4 major guided missile iterations with over 30 live-fire flight tests. They were invited to Ft. Hood to present their platform to the 1st Cavalry Division, and also briefed the Pentagon and U.S. congressmen on current U.S. vulnerabilities to advanced drone technology. Perseus Defense is actively standing up cooperative research agreements with U.S. Army DEVCOM's Applied Research Laboratory, Aviation and Missile Center, Armaments Center, and High Performance Computing Modernization Program.
companies.story: Perseus Defense 做的是反无人机系统，目标是成为美国本土的无人机防护罩。想象你是一个负责国土安全的官员，有小型无人机飞近机场或政府大楼，现有解决方案要么是一对一拦截，成本高得离谱，要么因为可能误伤平民而无法在城市使用。Perseus 的自导导弹平台可以单兵携带，能感知、追踪并摧毁威胁，单次拦截成本远低于传统动能武器。团队来自 YC 夏季批次，三人，正在招聘，两位创始人是航空航天工程博士和硕士，参与过 NASA 的火星直升机项目，也做过波音飞机的自主降落系统，这种硬核火箭科学背景让他们的方案值得关注。

companies.name: Amera

This cuts manual entry and exception handling, speeding up operations and reducing cost. We are already working with payers / plan administrators representing ~100k members, giving them access to more affordable care options.
companies.story: Amera 做的是医疗保险理赔处理自动化。想象你是一个保险公司的理赔审核员，每天面对堆积如山的 PDF 账单、收据和乱七八糟的 EDI 文件，手动录入数据不仅慢，还容易出错，导致拒赔和争议。Amera 能把各种非标准理赔文件自动转换成结构化数据，直接接入你现有的系统，省去大量人工录入和异常处理。这家公司来自 YC 秋季批次，团队十二人，已经和代表约十万会员的保险公司及计划管理方合作，让更多人能获得更便宜的医疗服务。对于理赔员来说，这意味着可以把时间花在真正需要判断的案例上，而不是重复劳动。

companies.name: Risely AI
companies.originalOneLiner: AI agents that automate administrative work across college campuses.
companies.originalDescription: Risely’s AI agents will form the new operating system for universities, improving retention, staff productivity, and efficiency. Our platform integrates directly into existing university systems (SIS, LMS, CRM), learns each institution’s unique workflows, and deploys specialized AI agents. This dramatically reduces the $735 billion universities spend annually on administrative labor, expands staff capacity without increasing headcount, and improves the student experience. This hasn't been done before because university workflows require nuanced, autonomous judgment, exactly what agentic AI was designed to solve. Our team uniquely combines deep expertise in higher education, enterprise-scale AI, and regulated enterprise sales. Sadia previously built Salesforce’s Education Cloud from scratch, creating the core Student Information System widely used across higher education. She deeply understands university operations and maintains trusted relationships with hundreds of higher-ed CIOs and Provosts. Danial was one of DoorDash’s earliest engineers, where he architected and scaled complex systems from zero to billions of transactions, including their search, recommendation, and Voice AI platforms. He knows how to build robust AI solutions that reliably perform at enterprise scale. Shahryar was a GM at Airwallex, where he built the entire Americas business from 0 to 1 and drove 11x revenue growth. He’s also a master closer, single-handedly securing over $17M in enterprise deals at NerdWallet. He’s a relentless startup executor with deep expertise launching and scaling go-to-market machines in highly regulated industries. We launched six weeks ago and are already at $8k MRR, growing 55% week-over-week -- one of the fastest ramps ever in higher ed. Universities urgently need solutions that expand labor capacity and efficiency, especially as they face unprecedented budget pressure and staffing shortages. With unmatched buyer access, deep technical expertise, and rapid early traction, we are perfectly positioned to own this enormous market.
companies.story: Risely AI 做的是大学行政工作的自动化，用人工智能智能体处理校园里的各种事务。想象你是一个大学招生办公室的负责人，每年申请季要处理成千上万份材料，还要协调各个院系的录取标准，现有系统又老又难用。Risely 的人工智能智能体直接接入学校的学籍系统、学习管理系统和 CRM，学习每个学校特有的流程，然后自动完成材料审核、课程安排、学生咨询等工作，减少行政负担。这家公司来自 YC 夏季批次，团队八人，创始人曾在 Salesforce 从零搭建教育云，深刻理解高等教育行业的复杂性，他们瞄准的是美国大学每年七千多亿美元的行政开支，这个市场足够大。

companies.name: Discovered Materials
companies.originalOneLiner: AI scientists to discover materials for the semiconductor industry.
companies.originalDescription: We use AI to discover new materials for the semiconductor industry - specifically datacenters and fabs. Finding novel materials today takes 10+ years of lab work. We aim to compress that timeline to months, using a swarm of AI agents. Akash completed his PhD at Stanford on material discovery for semiconductors. The materials he discovered for nanoscale interconnects have been adopted into the roadmaps of Intel and TSMC. Advaith was the founding applied scientist at Persona AI (acquired by Luma Labs), where he built long horizon autonomous agents for major telecom and crypto companies. Power consumption and heat release from AI chips is doubling every year. The semiconductor industry needs new materials to keep this exponential going - Discovered Materials will help find them.
companies.story: Discovered Materials 用人工智能为半导体行业发现新材料。想象你是一个芯片制造厂的工艺工程师，面临一个头疼的问题：芯片越来越小，发热越来越严重，现有材料已经快到极限，而实验室里研发一种新材料通常要十年以上。这家公司用一群人工智能智能体并行工作，把十年压缩到几个月。创始人是斯坦福博士，他发现的纳米级互连材料已经被英特尔和台积电采用，另一位创始人是 Persona 人工智能 的创始应用科学家，做过长时间跨度的自主智能体。团队来自 YC 春季批次，两人，正在招聘，随着人工智能芯片功耗每年翻倍，新材料的需求越来越迫切。

companies.name: AbInitio Bio
companies.originalOneLiner: The Intelligence layer for Drug Manufacturing
companies.originalDescription: Abinitio Bio builds foundation models for biomanufacturing, validated against wet lab data. Our first model, Echo, predicts manufacturing outcomes more accurately than standard models, and any pharma or CDMO can adapt it to their own workflow instantly. By making process decisions that take 6-18 months today in hours, we help teams avoid the cost of delay on a single program.
companies.story: AbInitio Bio 做的是生物制药制造环节的人工智能模型。想象你是一个生物制药公司的生产主管，正在为一批单克隆抗体设定培养条件，传统上这个过程需要六到十八个月的试验和调整，每次失败都意味着巨额损失。AbInitio 的模型 Echo 能根据湿实验室数据预测生产结果，比标准模型更准，而且任何药企或 CDMO 都能快速适配自己的流程，把决策时间从几个月缩短到几小时。这家公司来自 YC 春季批次，团队两人，虽然还很小，但生物制造是整个制药行业最烧钱的环节，哪怕只优化一点点，也能省下大量成本。

companies.name: Taiga
companies.originalOneLiner: Autonomous medical billing
companies.originalDescription: Taiga automates medical billing for doctor's offices. A doctor uploads their visit data, our AI figures out the right billing codes, checks the claim for errors, and submits it to insurance, dealing with any denials. Faster billing, fewer rejected claims, less busywork. We're Nanda and Adam, friends since 3rd grade. Both of our parents are doctors with their own practices, and billing was always a source of stress and lost revenue for them. We want providers to treat patients while we handle the rest.
companies.story: Taiga 做的是医生诊所的医疗账单自动化。想象你是一个小诊所的医生，每天看完病人还要花大量时间填写账单代码，错了就被保险公司拒付，追款又费时费力。Taiga 让你上传看诊数据，它会自动匹配正确的账单代码，检查错误，提交给保险公司，并处理拒赔问题。这家公司来自 YC 春季批次，团队两人，创始人是发小，父母都是开私人诊所的医生，他们亲眼看到账单问题带来的压力和收入损失。对于医生来说，这意味着可以把更多时间花在病人身上，而不是和保险公司扯皮。

readings.title: Show HN: Hi agent – run `npx microfeed/CLI manage` to deploy CMS on Cloudflare
readings.story: 很多人第一次接触部署，都会在命令行和配置文件里绕半天。明明只想把内容管理系统跑起来，却要先搞懂域名、缓存和边缘网络。这个项目把部署简化成一条命令，让人在 Cloudflare 上直接搭建 CMS。如果你曾经因为环境配置而放弃一个工具，或者想给团队找个低门槛的发布方案，这篇文章值得一看。读的时候留意作者怎么把复杂流程藏进简单命令背后，以及他为什么选择 Cloudflare 作为默认平台，这能帮你判断它适不适合自己的场景。

readings.title: Brave’s browser one-ups Chrome with its new support for email aliases
readings.story: 每天打开邮箱，总会收到各种订阅邮件，想退订又怕错过重要信息。这时候，如果浏览器能自动生成临时邮箱地址，就能把骚扰挡在门外。Brave 浏览器最近加了这个功能，比 Chrome 更贴心。这篇文章讲的就是这件事，它可能改变你管理在线身份的方式。读的时候可以想想，这个功能对普通用户意味着什么，是不是真的比用第三方邮件服务更方便，以及它会不会带动其他浏览器跟进。

readings.title: Microsoft Teams Has Become a Haven for Scammers in China
readings.story: 你可能以为诈骗只发生在电话或短信里，但现在连办公软件也不安全了。微软 Teams 在中国被骗子盯上，成了他们行骗的新场所。这听起来有点意外，毕竟 Teams 是正经的工作工具。这篇文章揭示了骗子如何利用平台的漏洞，以及为什么他们偏偏选 Teams。读的时候可以关注，平台在安全方面做了什么，又没做什么，以及作为用户，我们该怎么保护自己。
